text: Sheep at the gate, and no sheep will go first. {lead} comes round the back, low and quiet, and the flock files through. The farmer's thanks: a roll of notes.
Bubbles rise in the peat. {lead} follows them down and brings up, to its evident pride, Hag Stone.
{lead} skims a flat stone and it ticks off a row of stepping stones, each one settling a little. You hop after it, dry as a bone, mostly.
You hop back along the stepping stones. {lead} skims a stone ahead of you for luck, and it lands every time.
{lead} taps out a steady beat beside the hill and the earth begins to wriggle. Turned up with the worms: a few coins.
